summary: Frontend-only regression after Adams Rite drawings/catalog removal + visual refresh. Login, dashboard, Soumissions, Factures, quote/invoice editors, Catalogue quincaillerie, Coûts Master, Produits all render with no JS errors. Drawings button gone; Convertir en facture present. StatusBadge dots render everywhere. One design gap: the 'sticky' totals summary in DocumentForm does not actually stay visible while scrolling line items.

issues: Totals summary (md:sticky md:top-4 self-start) sits in a 2-col grid BELOW the line-items table, next to only the tax checkbox/notes. Grid row height ~205-237px vs totals box 180px, so it can stick for only ~25-57px. Measured: after scrolling the modal (scroll container = fixed inset-0 overlay), the totals box scrolled along with the content. It never stays visible while you scroll line items. To get the intended behaviour, put the totals in a side column next to the line-items table (e.g. a grid spanning lines + totals with the totals column sticky), or make the totals a sticky bottom bar inside the modal.

passed_checks: Admin login PortechAdmin / Portech2026! works (POST /api/auth/login 200, redirect to /admin)
Dashboard /admin/gestion/tableau-de-bord renders, 'Factures en attente' section present, 8 StatusBadge pills with colored dots (brouillon/envoyée...)

Soumissions: 2 rows, row action titles = [Convertir en facture (brouillon), Télécharger PDF, Envoyer par courriel, Modifier, Supprimer]. No Adams Rite/dessins button. quote-convert-* buttons present (2)
Quote editor modal opens (quote-modal) and shows Sous-total/TPS/TVQ/Total
Factures: 46 rows, 46 badges with dots (brouillon, en retard, envoyée). Overdue badge still shown
Catalogue quincaillerie: Articles (90), no 'Adams Rite' category. Only 2 user items whose description includes 'ADAMS RITE' (category Serrure, ADAM-MS1853*), which is expected
Coûts Master: Quincaillerie tab shows 102 items, 3 suppliers, 10 categories
Produits: 3 products (VD-99EO, AR-1850S 'Serrure Adams Rite' in category Serrures, VAL-001). No Adams Rite category
No runtime JS errors. Only pre-login 401s from the auth check and a dev-tooling hydration warning (<span> inside <option> in ProductsPanel category select, injected by visual-edit instrumentation)
action_items: Optional/design: make the DocumentForm totals summary actually sticky. Right now it is placed below the line items in a short grid row, so md:sticky has almost no effect.
critical_code_review_comments: DocumentPanel row action buttons Modifier/Supprimer have no data-testid (only title attributes). Add e.g. `${kind}-edit-${d.id}` / `${kind}-delete-${d.id}`
StatusBadge testId is optional, and DocumentPanel/DashboardPanel do not pass one. Consider passing `${kind}-status-${d.id}`
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login: use press_sequentially after networkidle on /admin/login (an immediate page.fill right after load did not log in, likely a hydration race). ERP routes are /admin/gestion/{slug}: soumissions, factures, catalogue-quincaillerie, couts-master, produits, tableau-de-bord. The modal scroll container is the fixed inset-0 overlay.
